announce.title: Casino Royal NYE — save the date
announce.body: New Year's Eve at Beachwalk. TownSq posted a save-the-date on Sep 15. It is now on the BeachWalk calendar as Dec 31 8 PM until they publish doors.

surveys.title: Holiday boat light tour — interest only
surveys.body: Proposed Sat Dec 12 sunset cruise plus holiday lights, about $75 a person. Survey only — not a ticket. A separate Punta Gorda bus cruise is already on the calendar that same day.
